function.name: _automatic_save_define
function.description: Save automation configuration. Used to create or update a complete automation workflow definition. Must call _read_informat_expression_doc first to read expression documentation before calling this method. Note: If no interactive steps are used, do not use automation; use scripts to implement the project instead. Steps with type starting with Output are interactive steps.

id.description: Automation ID (use camelCase naming, must be unique within the system, must not duplicate existing automation IDs, cannot be empty).
Input parameter type (String, Array<String>, Array<Object>, Integer, Double, Boolean, Object, HttpRequest).

name.description: Variable name. Strongly recommended to use camelCase naming, e.g. recordId. Use ${name} in step expressions to reference the variable value, e.g. ${recordId}.

data.description: Test data, only effective during local testing.

funcSettingList.description: Automation step list. Every step object, including child steps such as If.true/If.false inside children, must include a unique id, name, and type.

opt.description: Condition connection method. Only one of the following values can be used: and (AND), or (OR). Default is and.

Operator. Only one of the following values can be used (corresponding to Java OPT_* constants):
eq (equals), ne (not equals), gt (greater than), ge (greater than or equal), lt (less than), le (less than or equal),
contains (contains), notcontains (does not contain), startswith (starts with), endswith (ends with),
isnull (is null), isnotnull (is not null), in (in list), notin (not in list),
parentrooteq (root parent equals), parenteq (parent equals), parentcontains (parent contains),
multipleandquery (multi-value AND query), multipleorquery (multi-value OR query), intree (in tree)

value.description: Comparison value expression. If an expression function is used, it must be defined in the Informat Expression SDK documentation and must not be fabricated. Therefore, you must first call the tool `_read_informat_expression_doc` to read the expression documentation before generating any function.

func.description:
Field processing function name. Only one of the following values can be used:
length (length), nlevel (number of levels), nameOfAccount (account name),
day (day), month (month), week (week), quarter (quarter), year (year),
dayofyear (day of year), dayofmonth (day of month), weekofyear (week of year),
daytonow (days to now), weektonow (weeks to now), monthtonow (months to now),
quartertonow (quarters to now), yeartonow (years to now),
fmtday (formatted day), fmtweek (formatted week), fmtmonth (formatted month),
fmtquarter (formatted quarter), fmtyear (formatted year),
hour (hour), minute (minute), second (second)

var.description: Whether it is an expression. Must be set to true, indicating the value is an expression. Default is true.

FieldMappingItem.description: Field assignment mapping.user for InsertRecord / UpdateRecord。

valueType.description: Value type. Must be set to var, indicating the value is an expression.

type.description:
Step type. [Strict constraint] Only the following values are allowed:
[Control Flow] If (conditional branch), If.true (true branch), If.false (false branch), ForEach (loop), While (conditional loop), CallScript (call script function), SetReturnValue (set return value)
[UI-Dialog] OutputConfirm (confirmation dialog), OutputUpload (upload file), OutputUploadExcel (upload Excel), OutputDynamicForm (dynamic form), OutputDynamicTable (dynamic table), OutputRecordInfo (record detail), OutputRecordCreate (create record form), OutputRecordSelect (select record), OutputFormDesigner (form designer), OutputOpenFile (file preview), OutputRichtext (rich text dialog), OutputString (string dialog), OutputPageDesigner (print template), OutputOpenSplitDrawer (drawer/dialog), OutputOpenWebsite (open website page)
[UI-Toast] OutputToast (toast message), OutputNotification (notification)
[UI-Form] OutputSetFormValue (set form field value), OutputFormValidate (form validation), OutputRecordFormRefresh (refresh form), OutputCloseRecordInfo (close record detail), OutputSetFormTableSelection (set form sub-table selection)
[UI-Table] OutputTableRefresh (refresh table), OutputTableEvent (table event), OutputRefreshTableViewColumn (refresh columns), OutputSetTableViewFilter (set filter), OutputSetTableViewFilterCondition (set filter conditions), OutputSetTableViewOrderBy (set sort order), OutputSetTableViewExpand (set expand state), OutputSetTableViewSelection (set selection), OutputSetTableViewActiveRecords (set active records), OutputSetTableViewRootRecordId (set root node), OutputSetTableViewData (set table data)
[UI-Dashboard] OutputRefreshDashboardCard (refresh dashboard card), OutputSetDashboardFilter (set dashboard filter)
[UI-Page] OutputOpenUrl (open URL), OutputExternalUrl (external page), OutputSetExternalUrl (set external URL), OutputCloseModuleVisitHistory (close visit history)
[UI-Print/Download] OutputPrintRecord (print record), OutputPrintRecordList (print record list), OutputPrintByPageDesigner (print by template), OutputDownloadFile (download file), OutputDownloadExcel (download Excel)
[UI-Script/Clipboard] OutputInjectScript (inject script), OutputExecuteScript (execute script), OutputCopyClipboard (copy to clipboard), OutputGetAppClipboard (get app clipboard), OutputSetAppClipboard (set app clipboard)
[UI-Media/Scanner] OutputPlayAudio (play audio), OutputPlayImage (preview image), OutputQRCodeScanner (QR scanner)
[UI-Search/Message] OutputTextindexSearch (full-text search), OutputWebsitePageFireEvent (fire website page event)
[UI-BPMN] OutputBpmnEvent (BPMN event), OutputBpmnProcess (start BPMN process), OutputBpmnTaskInfo (BPMN task info), OutputBpmnInstanceInfo (BPMN instance info)

retValues.description: Output variable list of the current step. Subsequent steps can reference them using ${variableName}. [Strict constraint] retValues[*].id is the platform internal return key and must use the fixed value specified by this step's rule; do not change it to a business variable name. CallScript retValues is fixed to exactly three items: {id:'result',name:'Return value'}, {id:'code',name:'Error code'}, and {id:'message',name:'Error message'}; other single-return steps such as OutputDynamicForm and OutputRecordSelect are fixed to exactly one item: {id:'result',name:'Return value'}. id must not be changed to recipients, selectedTasks, sendResult, or any other custom name. Only name may be changed, and subsequent steps reference the variable by name.

id.description: Variable ID (platform internal return key, not customizable). Single-return steps must use result; CallScript must use the fixed result/code/message items; rare special steps such as ForEach use the fixed object/idx/list values specified by this schema.

name.description: Variable display name (used in expressions). This may be changed; subsequent steps reference it using ${name}.

ifFuncSetting.description: If is a control node and cannot execute logic directly. It must contain exactly two child nodes: If.true and If.false. Actual execution steps must be defined inside their children.

listVar.description: List expression such as ${list}. Must reference a variable from previous steps. Cannot be arbitrarily defined.

outputConfirmFuncSetting.description: Confirmation dialog configuration. Used to pause the automation flow and wait for user confirmation.

confirmTitleHorizontalAlign.description: Text horizontal alignment. Only one of the following values can be used: left (align left), center (align center), right (align right).

confirmTitleVerticalAlign.description: Text vertical alignment. Only one of the following values can be used: top (top), middle (middle), bottom (bottom).

uploadType.description: File storage mode. File = store in shared storage. Base64 = return Base64 encoded content.

maxSize.description: Maximum file size (MB). 0 means no limit.

outputDynamicFormFuncSetting.description: Dynamic-form output settings used to display an interactive form during an automation.

dynamicFormStyle.description: Form style. Required; omitting it prevents the form from rendering and leaves the dialog blank. Set it to "Simple".

dynamicFormFieldStyle.description: Form field style. Required; omitting it causes an invalid field layout. Set it to "fill".

dynamicFormStyleWidth.description: Form width. Required; omitting it leaves the dialog without a usable width. Default: 700.

dynamicFormStyleWidthUnit.description: Form width unit. Required and used together with dynamicFormStyleWidth. Set it to "px".

fieldId.description: Target field ID. Must exist in dynamicFormFieldList.

dynamicFormSubmitBeforeAutomaticId.description: Automation ID to execute before form submission.

dynamicFormSubmitBeforeAutomaticVarList.description: Parameter list for the pre-submit automation.

submitDisableExpression.description: Expression that controls whether the submit button is disabled.

dynamicFormEnableFieldValidate.description: Whether to enable field validation. Currently fixed to false; do not set it to true.

dynamicFormCloseAutomaticId.description: ID of the automation to run when the form closes.

dynamicFormCloseAutomaticVarList.description: Arguments passed to the automation that runs when the form closes.

setReturnValueFuncSetting.description: Set the return value of the automation.

whileFuncSetting.description: While loop. Repeats children steps while expression is true.

iftrueFuncSetting.description: If true branch marker node. No additional config.

iffalseFuncSetting.description: If false branch marker node. No additional config.

callScriptFuncSetting.description: Call a script function from a script module.

outputNotificationFuncSetting.description: Show a notification popup with title on the frontend.

position.description: Display position: top-right, top-left, bottom-right, or bottom-left.

recordCreateSubmitBeforeAutomaticId.description: ID of the automation to run before submission.

recordId.description: Record ID as a static value.

selectionMode.description: Selection mode: radio for single selection or checkbox for multiple selection.

cellEditMode.description: Cell edit mode: click or dblclick.

selectionStrictly.description: Whether strict mode is enabled so parent and child nodes are not linked in tree structures.

outputDynamicTableFuncSetting.description: Dynamic-table output settings used to display an interactive data grid.

cellEditMode.description: Cell edit mode: click or dblclick.

enableTableIndex.description: Whether to show the row-index column.

tableFieldList.description: Table column definitions. Important: every item must contain a field object of type TableFieldDefine, using exactly the same structure as outputDynamicFormFuncSetting.dynamicFormFieldList. Without field, the frontend cannot render the column. Set type to 'field'. field.id must match the outer id, field.key must use camelCase, and field.type determines the cell renderer and editor. Include the matching <typeCamelCase>Setting object for that field type, such as singleTextSetting for SingleText.

items.description: Table column definition. Set type to 'field' and use the field object to describe the column's field type and configuration.

id.description: Column ID. It must match field.id.

name.description: Column display name, normally the same as field.name.

field.description: The TableFieldDefine for this column. It uses exactly the same structure as a dynamic-form field and must contain id, name, key, type, and the matching <typeCamelCase>Setting object. Omitting field prevents the frontend from rendering the column.

buttonList.description: Buttons displayed in the column. Pass an empty array when there are no buttons.

If omitted or empty, the print page has no headers and the result is a completely blank table. Each item represents one column, normally a real data-table field.

outputBpmnProcessFuncSetting.description: Open the BPMN process start dialog and display the process start form. Required: bpmnModuleId (workflow module ID), bpmnProcessDefineId (process definition ID), bpmnProcessStartFormTableId (bound data table ID), and bpmnProcessStartFormFieldList (fields displayed on the start form). If the field list is missing or empty, the form displays no fields. Only bpmnProcessFormType = "Form" (data table form) is supported.

bpmnModuleId.description: Workflow module ID. A workflow module may contain multiple process definitions. This is different from bpmnProcessDefineId, and both are required.

bpmnProcessDefineId.description: Process definition ID identifying the specific process definition under the workflow module. Required; do not substitute bpmnModuleId.

bpmnProcessFormType.description: Start form type. Use the fixed value "Form" for a data table form.

bpmnProcessIdEnable.description: Whether to resolve the process definition ID from an expression.

bpmnProcessStartFormTableId.description: Data table ID bound to the start form. The field name must be bpmnProcessStartFormTableId, not tableId.

bpmnProcessFormEnable.description: Whether the process start form is enabled. Set to true when users must enter form fields.

bpmnProcessStartFormFieldList.description: Fields displayed on the process start form and whether each field is editable. Required and must not be empty.

visible.description: Whether the field is visible on the start form.

editable.description: Whether the field can be edited on the start form.

bpmnTaskId.description: Task ID as a static value.

openInNewWindow.description: Whether to open in a new window.

outputBpmnInstanceInfoFuncSetting.description: Open BPMN process instance detail dialog.

bpmnInstanceId.description: Process instance ID as a static value.

openInNewWindow.description: Whether to open in a new window.

AutomaticFunction.description: Automation step node. [Step id global rule (mandatory)] Every step node must have a unique id, including top-level funcSettingList steps and child steps such as If.true/If.false or loop children inside children; use a short random alphanumeric id and never omit it. [retValues global rule (mandatory)] retValues id is a platform return key, not a business variable name, and must strictly use the fixed value required by the step rule. Except for explicit exceptions such as ForEach (object/idx), QueryRecordList (list), and CallScript (result/code/message), every other single-return step has exactly one retValues item: {id:'result',name:'Return value'}; id must be result and must not be changed; name may be changed and is the variable name used by later steps. [type → Required setting and retValues rules (mandatory; missing any is a serious error)] [Control Flow] If → ifFuncSetting + children (exactly 2 children: first If.true, second If.false) If.true → no setting, child of If If.false → no setting, child of If ForEach → forEachFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'object',name:'List item'}, {id:'idx',name:'Index'}) While → whileFuncSetting, children steps SetReturnValue → setReturnValueFuncSetting [Call] CallScript → callScriptFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Return value'}, {id:'code',name:'Error code'}, {id:'message',name:'Error message'}; ids fixed, names editable) [Records] QueryRecordList → + retValues ({id:'list',name:'Record list'}), use ${Record list}.size() [UI-Dialog] OutputConfirm → outputConfirmFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Confirmed'}) OutputUpload → outputUploadFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'File list'}) OutputUploadExcel → outputUploadExcelFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Data list'}) OutputDynamicForm → outputDynamicFormFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Form data'}; id fixed, name editable) OutputDynamicTable → outputDynamicTableFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Record list'}) OutputRecordInfo → outputRecordInfoFuncSetting OutputRecordCreate → outputRecordCreateFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Form data'}) OutputRecordSelect → outputRecordSelectFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Data list'}; id fixed, name editable) OutputFormDesigner → outputFormDesignerFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Form data'}) OutputOpenFile → outputOpenFileFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'File list'}) OutputRichtext → outputRichtextFuncSetting OutputString → outputStringFuncSetting OutputPageDesigner → outputPageDesignerFuncSetting OutputOpenSplitDrawer → outputOpenSplitDrawerFuncSetting [UI-Toast] OutputToast → outputToastFuncSetting OutputNotification → outputNotificationFuncSetting [UI-Form] OutputSetFormValue → outputSetFormValueFuncSetting OutputFormValidate → outputFormValidateFuncSetting + retValues ({id:'result',name:'Validation passed'}) OutputRecordFormRefresh → outputRecordFormRefreshFuncSetting OutputCloseRecordInfo → outputCloseRecordInfoFuncSetting (no fields) OutputStableDiffusionSetForm → outputStableDiffusionSetFormFuncSetting [UI-Table] OutputTableRefresh → outputTableRefreshFuncSetting OutputTableEvent → outputTableEventFuncSetting OutputRefreshTableViewColumn → outputRefreshTableViewColumnFuncSetting OutputSetTableViewFilter → outputSetTableViewFilterFuncSetting OutputSetTableViewFilterCondition → outputSetTableViewFilterConditionFuncSetting TableFieldDefine.description: Field definition (TableFieldDefine). In addition to id, name, key, and type, include the matching <typeCamelCase>Setting object for the selected type, such as listSelectSetting for ListSelect or singleTextSetting for SingleText. Every declared setting field, including zero-value fields, must be included. Omitting fields can make the platform discard saved configuration. For ListSelect, omitting any of enableAppOption, optionShowImage, hiddenOptionRemark, optionTransferList, or showAllOptionInTable causes the entire optionList to be discarded.

id.description: Field ID. Use lowercase English letters and keep it unique.

key.description: Field key. Use English letters in camelCase and keep it unique.

type.description: Dynamic form field type. Use only one of: SingleText, MultiText, RichText, Integer, Double, Date, ListSelect, Attachment, Checkbox, User, Department, Coordinate, RelationRecord, Children, or ID.

singleTextSetting.description: Single-line text field configuration. Supply the complete structure and use zero values for fields that are not otherwise set.

format.description: Text format, such as string, email, url, or phone.

multiTextSetting.description: Multi-line text field configuration. Supply the complete structure.

userSetting.description: Member-selector field configuration. Supply the complete structure; otherwise the member selector may have no available choices.

dataSourceType.description: Data source: member, role, or department.

attachmentSetting.description: Attachment field configuration. Supply the complete structure.

maxSize.description: Maximum size of one file in MB.

editorType.description: Rendering style: select, radio, or checkbox.

optionList.description: Option list. It must not be empty unless options are loaded dynamically through dataAutomaticVarList; an empty optionList leaves the selector with no choices.

color.description: Option color. The value must be one of c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, or c8 (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, or gray). Do not pass a hexadecimal color such as #5B8FF9 or any arbitrary string. The platform accepts only these eight tokens; an invalid value causes the entire optionList to be discarded when saved.

format.description: Date format, such as d1 for date or d6 for date and time.
